question: India's first 'Musical Road', which plays the tune of "Jai Ho" when vehicles drive over it at a specific speed, has been inaugurated in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India’s first 'Musical Road' was recently inaugurated in Mumbai, specifically on the Bandra-Worli Sea Link (BWSL).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The road features specially designed rumble strips that vibrate against vehicle tires to play the melody of the Oscar-winning song "Jai Ho" by A.R. Rahman.**
 
• The musical effect is activated only when a vehicle passes over the stretch at a constant, designated speed (usually around 70-80 kmph).
 
• The primary objective of this project is to **encourage safer driving habits** and prevent speeding by providing an auditory reward for maintaining the correct speed.
 
• Technical Working__
 __
 
• Concept - Known as 'Melody Roads', these use the physics of sound and vibration created by varying the spacing between grooves on the road surface.
 
• Inauguration - It was inaugurated by Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Global Precedents__

 __
 
• The concept of musical roads originated in **Denmark** (the 'Asphaltophone' in 1995) and has since been implemented in countries like Japan, South Korea, and the USA.
 
 
 
• Safety Signage__
 
 
• The Mumbai traffic police have installed signboards before the musical stretch to alert drivers to maintain the specific speed required to hear the tune clearly.
